applicabilityBasis.summary: MYRC is a Blox-issued 1:1 Malaysian Ringgit stablecoin with public minting and redemption through the Blox platform. Blox's materials describe remittance, commerce, payment, and value-transfer uses, although its terms also say MYRC is not a payment instrument under Malaysian law without required local approvals.

genius.notes: Evidence as of 2026-10-07: Blox materials identify BLOX Blockchain Sdn. Bhd. as issuer and MYRC as 1:1 redeemable for MYR. The current onboarding guide accepts MyKad or passport, uses Malaysian banking rails, and describes payment and DeFi uses; it does not establish a Malaysian-residents-only rule. The product term sheet says MYRC is not legal tender, electronic money, a payment instrument or remittance tool under Malaysian law without required approvals and makes issuance/redemption subject to Blox discretion. Those local-law caveats do not erase its apparent payment-stablecoin design. The opened August 31 reserve examination, signed September 29, is an independent ISAE 3000 reasonable-assurance report by Tommy Ung & Partners PLT. No U.S. GENIUS approval, state qualification, official application, issuer-announced GENIUS pathway or foreign registration was located. Foreign-exception status remains unknown; the general GENIUS offer/sale restriction is not yet effective.
